name: Market Woman
fantasy: Queen of her stall, knows every price and wholesaler in town.

perks.name: Price Memory
perks.text: Spot price trends one day ahead to buy stock at optimal rates.

perks.name: Regular Customers
perks.text: Repeat buyers pay 5% above standard street margins.

weakness: Physical fatigue sets in quickly on lengthy market days.

name: Pure-Water Seller
fantasy: Fast on foot, carrying ice-cold sachets through humid Oshodi traffic.

perks.name: Afternoon Rush
perks.text: Peak pure-water sales during sweltering afternoon blocks.

perks.name: Agile Steps
perks.text: Sprinting between danfo queues consumes 20% less Energy.

weakness: Rainy blocks decimate demand and chill sales figures.

name: Traffic Hawker
fantasy: Weaving between idling bumpers with plantain chips, biscuits, and bottled drinks.

perks.name: Gridlock Radar
perks.text: Earn bonus profit when severe traffic jams stall the expressway.

perks.name: Pocket Change
perks.text: Never short on change; rapid transactions prevent missed car sales.

weakness: Draws heightened Heat from environmental enforcement task forces.

name: Phone Accessories Dealer
fantasy: Chargers, powerbanks, tempered glass, and sharp electronic bargaining.

perks.name: Accessory Margin
perks.text: Small portable items offer massive 40% retail markup.

perks.name: Flawless Fitting
perks.text: Free installation service builds fast customer Respect.

weakness: Delicate inventory easily damaged during unexpected downpours or scuffles.

name: Foodstuff Wholesaler
fantasy: Bags of rice, beans, garri, and tubers moving in dependable bulk shipments.

perks.name: Bulk Supplier
perks.text: Purchase wholesale sacks at a 15% discount directly from depot trucks.

perks.name: Essential Commodity
perks.text: Food items never lose demand regardless of economic hardship.

weakness: High warehouse storage overhead and transport freight fees.

name: Mama Put
fantasy: Steaming pots of jollof, amala, and pepper soup drawing loyal neighbourhood queues.

perks.name: Aroma Magnet
perks.text: Satisfied patrons tip extra and boost neighbourhood Respect.

perks.name: Free Sustenance
perks.text: Personal daily food expenses are completely eliminated.

weakness: Requires daily gas/kerosene fuel and grueling pre-dawn market trips.

name: Danfo Driver
fantasy: Master of the iconic yellow bus, reigning over the fast lane and bus parks.

perks.name: Yellow Rush
perks.text: Completes passenger routes 1 time block faster during peak hours.

perks.name: Rugged Chassis
perks.text: Danfo resists engine breakdown damage from rough potholed roads.

weakness: Primary magnet for union ticket levies and checkpoint inspections.

name: Conductor
fantasy: Door-hanging voice of the bus, calling destinations and collecting fares on the fly.

perks.name: Resonant Call
perks.text: Fills empty passenger seats twice as fast at crowded bus stops.

perks.name: Fare Tracker
perks.text: Zero fare loss from passengers attempting to slip away without paying.

weakness: High physical stamina drain and minimal baseline capital.

name: Okada Rider
fantasy: Two-wheeled navigator squeezing through impossible traffic gridlocks.

perks.name: Alleyway King
perks.text: Bypasses traffic penalties and gridlock delays entirely.

perks.name: Emergency Fare
perks.text: Stranded commuters gladly pay double fares during downpours.

weakness: High road hazard risk and restricted expressway zones.

name: Keke Driver
fantasy: Steering the yellow tricycle through inner street routes and quiet estates.

perks.name: Inner Street Charm
perks.text: Earns higher Respect and safer travel in residential zones.

perks.name: Fuel Sipper
perks.text: Consumes 30% less fuel per run compared to full-sized buses.

weakness: Cannot carry heavy freight or access restricted highways.

name: Bus Park Chairman
fantasy: Commanding loading bays, arbitrating route schedules, and leading driver unions.

perks.name: Daily Union Dues
perks.text: Collects passive morning revenue from active loading bays.

perks.name: Chairman Respect
perks.text: Commands commanding Respect among all commercial drivers and touts.

weakness: High Heat accumulation from municipal regulators and union competitors.

name: Dispatch Rider
fantasy: Cargo box mounted, delivering urgent packages and online orders across the metropolis.

perks.name: Priority Orders
perks.text: Consistent stream of guaranteed parcel delivery gigs.

perks.name: Street Navigator
perks.text: Minimal chance of getting lost or held up looking for tricky addresses.

weakness: Hefty financial penalties for damaged parcels or late deliveries.

name: Agbero
fantasy: Park and loading bay coordinator, commanding street levies with bold presence.

perks.name: Bay Command
perks.text: Loading levies pay 20% more during peak transit morning rush.

perks.name: Street Whistle
perks.text: Rallies street boys quickly to back your word in transit disputes.

weakness: High exposure to transport task force crackdowns and union clashes.

name: Vigilante
fantasy: Night watchman guarding residential gates and street compounds against burglars.

perks.name: Night Watch
perks.text: Earns steady weekly community security stipends from grateful landlords.

perks.name: Street Shield
perks.text: Reduces district Heat accumulation by maintaining peaceful streets.

weakness: Sleep deficit drains maximum daytime Energy by 10 points.

name: One Chance Operator
fantasy: A high-risk street hustler running deceptive schemes with severe moral consequences.

perks.name: Deceptive Hustle
perks.text: Generates bursts of high illicit cash on risky transit runs.

perks.name: Disappearing Act
perks.text: Higher agility when slipping through dense crowds during pursuit.

weakness: Severe Heat multiplier; massive Respect loss and heavy legal fines if exposed.

name: Landlord's Enforcer
fantasy: Tough compound bailiff recovering overdue rent arrears and enforcing eviction notices.

perks.name: Arrears Recovery
perks.text: Takes a 10% cash commission on all overdue compound rent collected.

perks.name: Iron Demeanour
perks.text: Bonus +2 Grit on all physical confrontation and door-step checks.

weakness: Despised by struggling compound tenants, reducing socialise Respect gains.

name: Pickpocket
fantasy: Fleet-fingered street runner navigating crowded terminal bottlenecks.

perks.name: Slick Fingers
perks.text: Extracts small opportunistic coins and bills in packed pedestrian queues.

perks.name: Alley Knowledge
perks.text: Escapes foot pursuit through narrow market drainage paths effortlessly.

weakness: Zero street trust; public outcry and instant clinic injury if caught in the act.

name: Politician's Youth Wing
fantasy: Grassroots campaign organizer coordinating party rallies, posters, and ward influence.

perks.name: Mobilization Allowance
perks.text: Receives substantial party mobilization allowances before public rallies.

perks.name: Ward Connection
perks.text: Local party patronage shields you from low-level street fines.

weakness: Vulnerable to fierce rival party clashes and sudden abandonment after election season.

name: Auto Mechanic
fantasy: Master of engines, clutches, and leaf springs along the Bolade auto strip.

perks.name: Engine Diagnostics
perks.text: Detects mechanical failures instantly, earning 20% bonus on diagnostic jobs.

perks.name: Trade Discount
perks.text: Buys vehicle replacement parts and oil at wholesale trade prices.

weakness: Grease and physical exertion rapidly deplete Stamina during afternoon sun.

name: Factory Hand
fantasy: Disciplined assembly and packaging specialist in the Isolo industrial zone.

perks.name: Shift Stamina
perks.text: Overtime shifts yield 25% higher wage bonuses on manufacturing quotas.

perks.name: Industrial Safety
perks.text: Reduces chances of fatigue-induced accidents on the factory floor.

weakness: Rigid clock-in schedules; penalty deductions for late arrivals.

name: Bank Clerk
fantasy: Crisp-shirted cashier and accounts handler managing high-volume cash flows.

perks.name: Ledger Balance
perks.text: Zero errors on financial balances, earning performance bonuses.

perks.name: Professional Demeanour
perks.text: Commands +2 Charisma in formal business and administrative dealings.

weakness: High stress from end-of-day ledger reconciliation and audit pressure.

name: Security Guard
fantasy: Uniformed corporate and warehouse protector keeping commercial premises secure.

perks.name: Perimeter Watch
perks.text: Earns reliable hazard bonuses for incident-free night surveillance.

perks.name: Authoritative Presence
perks.text: Defuses rowdy visitors at gate entrances without physical confrontation.

weakness: Monotony and extended standing shifts reduce recovery efficiency.

name: Generator Technician
fantasy: Emergency power technician keeping private generators and commercial dynamos running.

perks.name: Emergency Callout
perks.text: Callout rates surge by 30% during neighbourhood grid power cuts.

perks.name: Fuel Saver Tuning
perks.text: Tuned generators run with higher fuel efficiency, winning repeat client referrals.

weakness: Urgent night callouts frequently disrupt evening rest blocks.

name: Essential Worker
fantasy: Community pillar teaching neighbourhood children or nursing the clinic wards.

perks.name: Public Esteem
perks.text: Commands universal neighbourhood Respect across all social classes.

perks.name: Private Consultations
perks.text: Earns supplemental evening stipends from private tutoring and home healthcare.

weakness: Modest baseline salary requires consistent supplemental hustle.
